thread:
Maya K.: heads up — noticed a weird divergence on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate. p50 unchanged, p95 up ~120ms, p99 spiking intermittently. this looks correlated with routing weight shift at ~5412343000 but not sure.
Oliver P.: can you paste the endpoint slice? is this client-tagged or server-measured? sometimes client-side tokenization skews p95.
Maya K.: server-measured. endpoint breakdown by model variant: primary model shows normal tail, fallback variant has much higher p99. routing policy flipped small weight to fallback for a quota burst earlier.
Devon S.: that smells like aggregation provenance. are we showing mixed-origin percentiles in the same line? console may be blending p99 across route fallbacks.
Maya K.: exact worry. p50/p95 sourced from primary route only in some queries, but p99 comes from merged rollups that include fallback requests.
Rachel L.: UX idea: add a tiny provenance chip next to each percentile (badge: server|client|merged) + sample count tooltip. means users can immediately see if p99 is from merged data.
Oliver P.: agree. implementation caveat: our metrics API returns t-digest blobs for rollups. we currently merge at presentation layer for some queries — adding provenance requires us to return per-origin digests or counts in the API.
Devon S.: per-origin digests would blow up payload size. alternative: return meta counts per origin + origin-tagged sparse quantiles (p50,p95,p99) so console can annotate without full blobs.
Maya K.: proposal: API change to include provenance map: {origin: {count: n, p50: x, p95: y, p99: z}} for the endpoint breakdown endpoints. small extra bytes but very actionable.
Oliver P.: sounds reasonable. need to update routing docs too: when fallback weight >0 we should surface that in the endpoint selector and in the latency timeline overlay.
Rachel L.: UX mock — simple pill next to percentile label, hover shows counts and last change time. also add a checkbox: "show merged percentiles" default off for deep debugging.
Maya K.: quick repro commands for infra team if helpful:
```
# query example
curl -s "https://internal-metrics/v1/endpoint?route=/v1/generate&window=5m&group=origin" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq .
```
Devon S.: I ran that earlier. sample counts show 92% primary, 8% fallback but the fallback's p99 is 600ms so merged p99 jumps. you can see the p99 flip when fallback spikes.
Oliver P.: two immediate tasks: 1) small API PR to include the provenance summary for endpoint rollups; 2) console toggle + pill mock. I can do API PR, Rachel can own mock and frontend.
Rachel L.: will put a mock in Figma and attach to the ticket. brief: make chip subtle, color = amber for mixed/merged, green for single-origin stable.
Maya K.: filing a ticket: INF-64321 (notes + sample queries + screenshot). tagging @devon for perf numbers and @oliver for API changes.
deploy-bot: rollout-notice: routing weight change applied for route=/v1/generate at 5412343001 — primary=0.88 fallback=0.12 :information_source:
Devon S.: thanks — confirms correlation. I'll attach a small flamegraph and some kv-cache hit rates to the ticket.
Oliver P.: timeline: PR for API schema in next 24h, console mock by EOD, will add a feature-flag for the toggle. owners set.
Maya K.: great. follow-up: once API PR is up, I'll run the curl repro and validate p99 origin attribution in console staging. :thumbsup: 
Rachel L.: noted. I'll also add a tooltip copy that explains "merged p99 includes fallback requests when routing weight >0".
Maya K.: ok closing the thread here — thanks everyone.
